description: Anchor-phrase configuration used by src/uit_preprocessing.py to split data/uit/quy-trinh-danh-cho-sinh-vien.md into per-procedure sections. Anchors are exact substrings that must be located, in this order, inside the NORMALIZED document text (after newline/whitespace/unicode/bullet cleanup). A section spans from its anchor's start offset up to (but not including) the next procedure's anchor start offset. query_keywords are used by src/retrieval.py's MetadataFilter to infer the likely procedure_slug for a user query; they are intentionally separate from the section-detection anchors.
